hero.definition: A smile makeover combines two or more cosmetic treatments, usually porcelain veneers with whitening, gum contouring or crowns, planned as a single design. At Xiluet Smiles in Miami the veneer base is $6,000 and every add-on is itemised in your written estimate.
hero.lead: When one treatment is not enough. We combine what your smile needs, design it as a whole, and deliver it in one week in Miami.

image.alt: Woman in her forties with a relaxed, natural smile after her makeover
image.caption: Smile makeover · Designed for your face, delivered in one week

candidates.title: For smiles with more than one thing to fix
candidates.intro: A makeover combines treatments. These are the usual pieces.

items.d: Shape, length and color of the teeth that show when you smile.
Brightens the teeth veneers do not cover, so everything matches.
Evens a gummy or uneven gum line to frame the teeth.
For back teeth that are broken or heavily filled.
Small chips and edges on teeth that do not need veneers.

why.title: Designed together, so nothing looks added on.
why.body: A veneer shade chosen before whitening, or a gum line fixed afterwards, never quite matches. We plan the sequence once, so every piece follows the same design.

facts.label: Plan
facts.sub: Every treatment follows the same facial analysis.

facts.label: Sequence
facts.sub: Gums first, whitening next, veneers matched last.

facts.label: Time
facts.sub: For veneer-based makeovers. Aligners extend it.

facts.label: Material
facts.sub: Porcelain layered over a zirconia core on every tooth we restore: metal-free, stain-resistant and strong enough for daily chewing.

week.title: Your makeover week in Miami
week.intro: Photos and estimate from home. Then three visits in one week, in the right order.
week.linkLabel: Pick a date and see the full schedule →

visits.d: Send photos, get your written estimate within 6 hours, pick a payment plan and reserve with a $250 deposit.
visits.time: Any day, about 2 minutes of your time

visits.d: Scans, photos and design session. Whitening the same day so veneer shade is matched to your final color.
Gum line evened if planned, teeth prepared, temporaries fitted in your approved design.
Veneers and crowns bonded, bite checked, warranty handed over in writing.
visits.time: About 2 hours. Fly home the same evening.

price.title: Veneers priced upfront. Add-ons itemised in writing.
price.body: 20 veneers start at $6,000. Whitening, gum contouring or crowns are listed line by line in your written estimate within 6 hours of your photos, so you see the full number before you book.

card.title: 20 porcelain veneers
included: Whitening, gum contouring and crowns itemised separately

price.footnote: Prices shown are minimum fees. Your final fee is confirmed in writing after a doctor's evaluation.

faq.title: Makeover questions, answered by the doctors

items.a: Rarely. Most makeovers are veneers plus one other treatment. Your estimate lists only what your smile needs.
Porcelain does not whiten, which is why we whiten first and match the veneers to the result.
Done under local anesthesia. Expect mild tenderness for a few days.
Mild crowding is handled by the veneers. Severe misalignment needs aligners first, which adds months to the plan.
Veneers and crowns 10 to 15 years or more. Whitening 1 to 2 years, refreshed with touch-ups.

cta.title: Start with photos.
cta.body: Free, no visit needed. Written estimate included.
cta.cardBody: Two photos of your smile, from your phone. Takes 2 minutes.
